title: Choose the folio visual world
question: The roll assigned The Walk: student work as rooms you pass through. Keep it, take the inhabited-still pick, take a paper-volume alternate, or re-roll. Slideshow / numbered-reel contact sheets stay the standing exit only.

options.label: The Walk
options.lineage: thesis exhibition: colored rooms, wall labels, walking distance
options.thesis: The folio is a suite of rooms. Each piece owns a wall; scrolling is walking. Nothing swaps in one frame.
options.viewport: Full-bleed student still as the first wall; name as a small corner label; short bio in the picture; below, the next rooms as large hanging pieces, not a strip of thumbs.
options.risk: Can read as a museum site if wall labels outrank the student’s work.

raised.raise: One cantilever sightline carries the eye from the name, through the hanging, into the next room — not stacked boxes.
Each room floods with a color committed from the still; the page is the color, not a gray gallery with accents.
A traveling warmth band along the floor marks where you stand in the suite, never a numbered shot rail.
Thin type sits in the student’s still; the still is the portal. No chrome stage around a swapped frame.
Pieces hang at different heights and depths. One slot that swaps stills is forbidden.

options.riskLine: Museum chrome can swallow the student.

options.label: Ground
options.lineage: inhabited still: type in the picture, then a flowing page of large pieces
options.thesis: The student’s own image is the world you stand in. Work is chapters of a landscape, never slides of a reel.
options.viewport: Student still owns the viewport; name and a short line sit in the scene; a horizontal row of large rounded pieces begins below the fold.
options.risk: This is the familiar destination given the attached refs; most runs here land on a meadow-with-type hero.

options.label: Lantern
options.lineage: akari workshop: washi volumes, bamboo ribs, one bulb
options.thesis: Each piece is a glowing paper volume in a dim room. You move between lit works, not through a reel.
options.viewport: A warm paper lantern of the lead still fills the first room; student name as a brush-stamp; unlit pieces wait as rib outlines.
options.case: Holds audience identification (studio craft, paper, light) but loses product clarity: lanterns can hide that this is a student’s published work.
options.risk: Reads as a lamp shop if the still is treated as shade instead of the artifact.

options.label: Starburst diner
options.thesis: The folio as a swooping counter under a neon starburst.
options.viewport: Cantilever roof line from name to work to booths of pieces.
options.case: Loses both axes: AFM students do not identify with a diner, and chrome orbits bury the stills.
options.kept: One continuous cantilever sightline instead of stacked chrome.

options.label: Racing livery
options.thesis: Pieces as liveried crafts; picking one floods the page with team color.
options.viewport: A craft-shaped still with oversized numerals racing left to right.
options.case: Loses both: invented sponsor energy fights student-work honesty.
options.kept: Page-scale color flood committed from the still.

options.label: Daylight section
options.thesis: The folio as an architectural section the sun walks through.
options.viewport: A long section drawing with the still occupying a sunlit room.
options.case: Loses both: solar timestamps and poche obscure student pieces.
options.kept: A traveling warmth band that marks place without numbering shots.

options.label: Shader portal
options.thesis: A GPU scene fills the screen; type floats over living pixels.
options.viewport: One hero word over a breathing mesh; corner links dissolve scenes.
options.case: Loses both: a synthetic mesh would replace the student’s still as the first artifact.
options.kept: Thin type living inside the picture; the still is the portal.

options.label: Nixie counter
options.thesis: Quantities glow as stacked glass digits.
options.viewport: Tube banks of shot numbers as the interface.
options.case: Loses both and collides with the anti-goal: numbered tubes are a slideshow with extra glass.
options.kept: Physical depth: pieces occupy different hanging heights, never one swapping slot.

canonCard.label: Contact sheet
canonCard.thesis: The category standard: numbered stills, one owning stage, a strip of thumbs. Played straight, not as a joke.
canonCard.viewport: Punched sheet, shot 01 on the stage, six-up strip below.
canonCard.risk: This is the slideshow the brief asked to leave.
